'''Chapter 425''' is titled "Bridge of Mortal Combat".

==Cover Page==
[[Where They Are Now]], Shot 2: "[[Wyper]] and the [[Shandia]], Forest Pioneers."

With no more war, [[Wyper]] and his fellow warriors are busy building a new village in the forests of [[Upper Yard]]—but not so busy they have no time for lunch breaks.

==Short Summary==
The [[Straw Hat Pirates]], [[Franky]] and the [[Shift Station]] staff watch the battle between [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] and [[Rob Lucci|Lucci]].

==Long Summary==
The assault from the [[Buster Call]] continues and [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]]'s battle with [[Rob Lucci]] rages on. The battleships report that all [[Marines|Marine]] and [[World Government]] personnel are safely aboard. They also report fifty [[pirate]]s at the main gate, and everyone on the main island is dead, much to everyone's shock and horror, and that the only structure not obliterated was the [[Bridge of Hesitation]]. When [[Nami]] asks if people can just die so easily, [[Nico Robin|Robin]] replies that humans cannot be seen on a map. She says that the Buster Call is erasing an island from the map, without any hesitation. [[Franky]] then yells for Luffy to hurry up.

Back underground, Luffy is fighting Lucci after having activated [[Gomu Gomu no Mi/Gear 2 Techniques|Gear 2]]. Luffy uses [[Gomu Gomu no Mi/Gear 2 Techniques|Gomu Gomu no Jet Pistol]] and blasts Lucci back. Lucci uses [[Six Powers/Shigan|Shigan]], but Luffy dodges it. They both punch each other but both block each other's punch. Luffy then hits Gomu Gomu no Jet Bullet and hits Lucci in the stomach and follows it up with another Jet Pistol. Lucci then tells Luffy he will show him the most powerful [[Six Powers]] technique. He clenches his fists and brings them to Luffy's stomach. He uses the technique, [[Six Powers/Rokuogan|Rokuogan]], to unleash a massive shockwave on Luffy's body. Luffy compares it to the [[Dials#Impact Dial|Impact Dial]] from [[Skypiea]], only with a greatly amplified power. While Luffy is on the ground, Lucci uses Rankyaku Gaicho, causing an explosion. [[Tony Tony Chopper|Chopper]] muses that it is almost like Luffy knows who he should fight from the start. A soldier reports to one of the [[Marine Ranks#Vice Admiral|Vice Admirals]] that they spotted Luffy, and he orders all ships to make a battle formation around the Bridge of Hesitation.

==Quick Reference==

===Chapter Notes===
*The battleships report that all [[Marines]] and [[World Government]] personnel are safely on board, and the main island of [[Enies Lobby]] has been destroyed with everyone still present at the main island dead.
*The battleships begin targeting the Bridge of Hesitation.
*[[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] compares [[Rob Lucci|Lucci]]'s [[Six Powers/Rokuogan|Rokuogan]] to an [[Impact Dial]] from [[Skypiea]].
